source.title: חוק מילווה קצר מועד, תשמ"ד-1984 (Nevo mirror)

regulator.notes: The state borrows; the Bank of Israel sells the bills to the public by auction, administers the loan and runs the register (Short-Term Loan Law ss.1(א), 4, 5, 6, 10). The securities account that holds the paper is supervised separately: a bank by the Supervisor of Banks, a non-bank TASE member by TASE under the ISA (BRK-04, REG-13).

source.title: Banking (Service to Customer) (Fees) Rules 2008, First Schedule part 4 (BoI copy, consolidated to 9.4.2025)
source.publisher: Bank of Israel, Supervisor of Banks

custody.notes: A bank may not charge "דמי ניהול פיקדון ניירות ערך" for makam (First Schedule part 4(א)(5) note 2). Buy, sell and redemption commissions in part 4 still apply, with a separate makam line priced by each bank (BRK-16). The ban binds banks only: no rule limits a non-bank TASE member's custody fee on makam (BRK-17, BRK-52; BRK open question 11 closed 2026-10-26), so its tariff applies as published.

labels: conflict noted: the Tax Authority guide 2025 (p.39) says 20% on makam discount, the statute (s.125C(c)) says 15%; the site computes 15% and flags it (TXI OQ3, G-09)

lawful_exit.text: Any trading day: makam is listed on TASE after each auction and can be sold at the market price of the day (GOV-04, GOV-17, GOV-22). Held to the redemption date, the Bank of Israel pays the face value (GOV-03). The settlement cycle for a secondary sale on TASE was not readable (GOV open question 7), so no payout-days figure is recorded.

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Selling one makam series to buy another is a sale (s.88 "מכירה"): the gain on a sale before redemption is a capital gain on an unlinked asset at up to 15%, withheld by the bank or member (TXI-12, TXS-05).

eligibility.text: any individual with a securities account at a bank or at a non-bank TASE member (BRK-32): a purchase on TASE on any trading day, or a bid in the monthly issue auction through the account (GOV-22). Only TASE clearing-house members bid directly (GOV-05); the minimum and fee for an individual's auction order are open (GOV open question 2), and the TASE trading unit and minimum trade were not readable (GOV open question 7). A bank through which makam can be bought must show it next to deposits and money-market funds under "מוצרי שוק הכסף" and explain how to buy it (BANK-15)

protection.text: the face value is paid from the state's general revenues, an obligation of the state and not of the bank or broker (GOV-02). The paper sits in a securities account: at a non-bank TASE member client securities are held apart from the member's own, in trust at the TASE clearing house, under TASE rules (BRK-07; no statute was found, REG open question 9); at a bank they are registered through the nominee company, pooled, and separated from the bank's own in its books (BRK-10, one bank's terms). What happens to client securities if a bank fails was not found in an official source (REG open question 10); a guarantee of a failing bank's deposits is discretionary (REG-06)
